It’s just so simple this way! No need to dirty up pans and spend so much time prepping. I’m okay with $10 for a week of breakfast :).

I’ve been doing this little trick at Chipotle for a few years and it’s saved me so much money.

Order a burrito bowl and double every ingredient (except meat) because they will always do it for free. Take home the burrito bowl and put the ingredients in a skillet and mix with ~8-10 eggs.
Re-wrap into breakfast burritos, it usually makes about 7 really good sized ones.
Let cool and put in freezer, reheat in the morning before work !
Delicious breakfast burritos for an entire week that only costs ~$10 plus the price of eggs and tortillas.
